Speak with Camp Guard Pongtu and Imperial Guardsman Tingjo in order to acquire a shelter pass.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Camp Guard Pongtu|Guardsman Pongtu]] {{sic}} in Xaquang Skyway.
* Locate [[Imperial Guardsman Tingjo]] in the [[Shenzun Tunnels]]. Obtain a shelter pass from him.
* See Yikaro for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
After obtaining the quest, speak to Camp Guard/Guardsman Pongtu who is a few steps away from Yikaro. Imperial Guardsman Tingjo can be found outside of [[Maatu Keep]] in Shenzun Tunnels. When you go near Tingjo, several groups of [[Afflicted]] will approach Tingjo and attack; however, the quest doesn't require you to defend Tingjo from the Afflicted, so you can speak to him before the Afflicted arrive to receive the shelter pass and [[map travel]] to [[Senji's Corner]] to collect your reward. 

==NPCs==
===Allies===
* {{w}} 20 [[Canthan Guard]]s
* {{w}} 20 [[Imperial Guardsman Tingjo]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Yikaro'''
:''"I am sorry to bother you, but...please...I could really use some help. I lost my wife to the plague, and the ministry burned down our house during the quarantine. Now, my children and I have nowhere to go. The guards will not let us in to the refugee camp without a shelter pass, but unfortunately, in the mad rush to leave our home, I forgot our pass. When I returned to get it, the house was already engulfed in flames. Please...can you help me procure a '''shelter pass''' for me and my children? I was told that '''Guardsman Pongtu''' {{sic}} here in Xaquang Skyway might have a few left to hand out."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = For the children!
|decline = I don't have time to help you right now.
|ask =  Were you able to get a shelter pass from '''Guardsman Pongtu'''? {{sic}} My children are tired of sleeping alongside bums and vagrants.
|indent = :: }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Camp Guard Pongtu'''
:''"If you are looking for a shelter pass, I cannot help you. My orders are to let no one through without one. If you are in dire straights, I suggest you look for Imperial Guardsman Tingjo. He is currently combing the sewers for survivors, giving out passes to those in need."''

'''Imperial Guardsman Tingjo'''
:''"Your friend is in luck. I have been authorized to hand out passes to those needing shelter. Have your friend give this pass to the camp guards, and he and his family will be allowed inside."''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Yikaro'''
:''"There are not many who would put their own lives at risk to help out strangers. My family is eternally grateful for your assistance. May [[Dwayna]] keep you safe in this troubled time."''

== Notes ==
* The shelter pass is not an actual [[quest item]] as it doesn't appear in your inventory when you receive it from Tingjo.

{{Bug|[[Camp Guard Pongtu]] is incorrectly identified as ''Guardsman Pongtu'' in the quest log.}}
